column1: # ESP32-S3 16MB. Dual OTA slots plus a LittleFS script partition.
# app0 stays the stock 0x640000. app1 is 128KB smaller so `littlefs` fits
# between the apps and the unchanged `spiffs` partition (ML model cache).
# OTA writes an app slot only. Do not erase `littlefs` (no erase_flash
# no esp_partition_erase on this label). A full flash is required once so
# this table replaces default_16MB.csv; later app uploads keep script files.
